slides.headline: A stop-loss is the [exit] you plan before you need it

slides.title: How it works
paras: Buy at <g>$100</g>, set a stop at <g>$90</g>. The price falls to $70: the stop sells near $90. You lose about <g>10%</g>, not 30%.

slides.title: Why small losses matter
paras: The bigger the loss, the harder the climb back. That is the whole point of cutting early.

slides.title: 3 rules to use it
paras: A stop is a plan, not a guarantee. Not financial advice.

rows: Decide calmly, not in a panic
Fast moves can skip past your price
